name: agentic-workspace
description: The workspace context kit's plugins: closeout, the end-of-session promotion ritual; projects, the life of a project from capture to close; and workspace, the first-time setup and the upkeep that follows.

plugins.name: closeout
plugins.description: A safety net for the end-of-session documentation ritual: /closeout promotes learnings live and brings the project's Now block and Done when list up to date, and if you forget, a SessionEnd hook captures the learnings into a draft the next session offers to promote.

plugins.name: projects
plugins.description: The life of a project, kept in its README: /projects:new and /projects:adopt set the finish line and next action; /projects:capture fills the team inbox; /projects:board shows everything in flight with flags; /projects:review is the regular tracking pass; /projects:close finishes a project with evidence and a retrospective; /projects:pickup briefs whoever takes one over; /projects:mine lists one person's actions for their own system. A session-start hook says where the folder's project stands.

plugins.name: workspace
plugins.description: Set up and look after a shared agentic workspace: /workspace:quick-start interviews the team and each person and wires the kit into their daily and weekly routines; /workspace:hygiene runs the weekly tidy of where context lives; /workspace:register-audit checks guidance files for the register they are written in.
